name: finickizer
title: Finickizer
description: Browser chooser for Finicky: open a link once, or remember a rule for its domain
author: trollfred

commands.name: choose
commands.title: Choose Browser
commands.description: Pick a browser for a URL, optionally remembering a Finicky rule for its domain

commands.name: browsers
commands.title: Manage Browsers
commands.description: Pick and order the apps shown by Choose Browser

commands.name: rules
commands.title: Manage Rules
commands.description: List, reorder, retarget and delete the rules remembered from the chooser

commands.name: patch
commands.title: Patch Finicky Config
commands.description: Make Finicky load ~/.finickizer.js, which wraps your own config, and pick when the chooser opens

commands.name: unpatch
commands.title: Unpatch Finicky Config
commands.description: Move your own config back to ~/.finicky.js, optionally deleting the remembered rules

commands.name: reload
commands.title: Reload Finicky Config
commands.description: Make Finicky pick up edits to your own config. Also runs by itself every minute.
